messages.subject: latticist is not supported in Rattle 4.1.0 ?
parts:
Hi,
I installed Rattled 4.1.0 in Ubuntu 14.04. It work so far so good except that latticist seems not being supported by Rattle 4.1.0. Is it true ?

Paul

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: latticist is not supported in Rattle 4.1.0 ?
parts:
The latticist package is no longer supported by its author on CRAN and hence can not be included in Rattle.

Regards,
Graham Williams
